items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Like there was a fellow called Jesse Pinkett, and there was a fellow called Jack the Bear. ... And that's where I met such fellows like Jack the Bear, playin' the piano.

ctx.x: Well, this other fellow was trying to play the piano, too. So we had -- we used to go around and if he heard anything, he'd come in and tell me about it. And if I heard anything from somebody -- one of the great guys that was playing around there -- cause there were fellows playing. Like there was a fellow called Jesse Pinkett, and there was a fellow called Jack the Bear. So, they were playing and I'll tell you about another man a little later on -- that year, we went to Atlantic City again, because every summer…

Well, my brothers were much older now, they had started going away to school. Because they had a little difficulty going to the high schools in -- especially in the Catholic high school, at that time in Philadelphia. They weren't at the place where "JACK THE BEAR" WILSON.
